prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas. Injury: shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1479; do not mention it.)
text: I was driving north on the frontage road in League City, Texas, and moved into the right lane to get ready for my exit. As I started to merge, I checked my mirror and saw nothing close beside me, but a few seconds later a vehicle in that lane made contact with the passenger side of my car, pushing me toward the curb. I pulled onto the shoulder and stopped. Both vehicles had visible scraping along the doors and panels. The other driver and I exchanged insurance information, and I took photographs of the damage and the roadway. My right shoulder was wrenched when the impact jolted me against the seatbelt, and I have had pain and reduced range of motion since then. I sought medical evaluation shortly afterward and am following the treatment plan my provider recommended.
